What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I've worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. title: Sustain Platforms Manager
description: At IAG, we’re ready for you. We're the largest general insurance group in Australia and New Zealand. Our family of brands turns the IAG purpose of making your world a safer place into action by helping everyday Aussies and New Zealanders, supporting their ambitions and making insurance accessible.  Help shape the next chapter of IAG’s technology transformation. As a Sustain Platforms Manager, you’ll lead teams responsible for maintaining critical business applications while broader transition and modernisation activities take place. Balancing operational excellence with continuous improvement, you’ll ensure platforms remain reliable, secure and cost effective while supporting a changing technology landscape. Working closely with business stakeholders, partners and vendors, you’ll bring people together, navigate complexity with confidence, and help create a stable foundation that supports the journey towards a simpler and more sustainable future.  This is a permanent full-time role based in Tāmaki Makaurau (Auckland), Te Whanganui-a-Tara (Wellington) or Ōtautahi (Christchurch).     Ngā Mahi Hei Whakatutuki Māu | What You'll Do       Lead teams responsible for business-critical platforms, ensuring reliable service delivery and strong operational performance throughout a period of transformation.   Define and deliver platform sustainment strategies that balance business value, operational stability, risk management and cost optimisation.   Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance platform performance, resilience and long-term sustainability.   Partner with vendors, technology teams and business stakeholders to manage support services, transition activities and delivery outcomes.   Champion engineering excellence, automation and emerging technologies, including opportunities to leverage AI and improve efficiency.   Guide investment, demand and platform health decisions through effective governance, prioritisation and performance monitoring.

title: Chief of Staff - CCO (m/w/d)
description:
Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust einen Datensatz mit allen relevanten Hausverwaltungen auf

  • Du unterstützt bei der Due Diligence und der Angebotserstellung

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Working closely with our Relationship Managers, our legal and valuation panels and our Underwriting teams you will be responsible for a portfolio of lending cases, managing all relevant activity to progress the case efficiently and effectively through to completion. If you think you can deliver operational excellence in the Commercial Lending arena, this is the role for you.

  • Deliver post-sanction administration to Commercial Mortgages and other lending i.e. GGS loans, Overdrafts and Business Loans, ensuring timely release of communications, legal and valuation instructions and payments to support the bank’s ethos of fast, high-quality service.

We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.

Full-time

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.
